title: Flashing Red
subtitle: Sharp and glaring. I can tell it's the color of warning.

items.text: Flashing Red

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Oh. You're also here?
Sonetto hears her. She stops the practice.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes ... I am taking combat drills with the Artificial Somnambulism training system.
Lilya casts a sideways look at the screen in front of Sonetto. There shows her overall time length of practice.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Six hours ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I'm not the only one goofing around.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: No, I'm not. I am not goofing around.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I am waiting for orders.
Her face flushes scarlet.
Lilya initiates the machine in front of her, unaware of her awkwardness.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Well, much luckier than me.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I have so many things to bitch about ... "One who plays hooky." Have you heard it? Literally me.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I should have turned down the offer when they promoted me to the Foundation headquarters. They don't have any field missions for a flying witch …

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Is it because of the provisions of Talent Protection?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Only God knows.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: House Arrest may be a better name.
She throws a casual glance at the screen.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Look, since we're both bored to death, do you want to have a try at some difficult things?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What is it?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hm, this.
She pouts her lips, hinting at something which she thinks should be obvious to both of them.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Have you tried the Artificial Somnambulism joint training?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Put on the helmet together, and switch to multiplayer mode …

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Two operators can take on a harder training mode ... more insane enemies ... Haha.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Like playing in the arcade.
Sonetto stares blankly at Lilya as she operates the machines.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: O-Okay. Shall I turn this red knob?
She is a bit worried, not sure what to do; she has to imitate what Lilya just did.
And she murmurs ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... What is an arcade?
The floor starts to vibrate as the machine goes into function.
The multiplayer mode has been initiated.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: What did you say? I can't hear you with my helmet on.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Whoo, nice controller. Good! I'm entering the zone now.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: It's been a long time. Why not have some fun?
She quickly taps on some buttons, and the warning indicator on Sonetto's equipment suddenly flashes a red light.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The light is flashing ... What did you press?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I switched it to the hardest mode! Haha! You better get it together!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: W-Wait ...
But there's no time to "wait." Two words in big red font appear on the screen in front of them: DRILL STARTS.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Don't fail me, top student.
The helmet has cut off their vital fluids and diverted them to a pre-programmed battlefield. The operators' vision is about to change ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: *breathing out* ... I am ... exhausted.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Ha ... Almost choking.
They take off their helmets, slumping onto the floor together.
Their gloves are soaked in sweat.
They subside into momentary silence, looking at each other.
They burst into laughter in high spirits.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hahahahaha ... hahaha ... I haven't had so much fun for centuries!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Heh heh ... Hahaha ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: How many times did we die?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Sorry, haha ... I cannot do math now.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: My mind ... goes blank ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hahahaha ... who would expect THE Sonetto would have a brain fade ...
Lilya falls backwards, lying on her back, staring at the white ceiling with peaceful joy.
Sonetto leans on the wall, exhausted.
It was a fight of verve and vitality. All the noises that have been nagging them for days now seem to have disappeared.
There are only breaths, the wind, and the smell of the concrete floor.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Have you heard the result of the debate?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I heard that ... the number of people opposing the draft significantly increased after the debate.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hm ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: It's not going well.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Soon will be the voting session. The opposition is taking the lead.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... I hope Ms. Druvis can hold out.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: You visited them?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I submitted a request to enter that building ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The system arranged guards to accompany me to ensure my safety.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The moment they entered the building, they started sawing the trees ... saying that they need to carve out the path.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Since then ... I have not been there.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Four and a half weeks. After that, they can't hold on for any longer.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Really? In that case ... the vote result has to come out before that.
Sonetto is deep in contemplation.

items.speaker: Secretary Sharon
items.text: Hi, may the peace be with us.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Hello! May the peace be with us.

items.speaker: Secretary Sharon
items.text: Do you mind giving us some privacy?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Do whatever you like.
They walk to the break room in the hallway.

items.speaker: Secretary Sharon
items.text: Here is Madam Z's message. Please visit her in the office on Friday.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ah ... Okay. Copy that! Thank you for the message.

items.speaker: Secretary Sharon
items.text: With pleasure.
She nods and places her hand on her chest.

items.speaker: Secretary Sharon
items.text: Wish you a good day.
Secretary Sharon leaves the room at a quick trot.
When Sonetto returns to her exercise equipment, she finds Lilya is about to leave the room.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Are you leaving?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Yes.
She picks up her gloves and the canteen but hesitates. She pauses for a brief moment, then quickly turns back to Sonetto.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Do you know how the penalties for destruction of public property of the Foundation and brawl are determined?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Well, according to Measures of the Foundation for Administrative Penalties, based on the severity of the circumstances, fines will be imposed and the offender's salaries shall be deducted accordingly in minor cases, while detention or expulsion shall be imposed in major cases.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The penalty also depends on what is damaged. For example, production tools, household goods, buildings, equipment, facilities, etc. These are the properties that involve less cost and limited influence if damaged.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: If the number of people involved in a brawl is equal to or less than eight, and there are no major casualties, the penalty will be minor.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: May I ask what happened? Why are you asking this all of a sudden?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Nothing. As I said, bored to death.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: So bored that I have been paying attention to the Foundation's regulations. Even the Flying Manuals failed to win this much of my attention.
She waves at her and leaves without looking back.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: So long, Sonetto. Hopefully there is good news for us next time I see you.
TO BE CONTINUED…
